page.content:
Live D&D actual-play of Vox Machina, the Mighty Nein, and Bells Hells in Exandria.

How Critical Role connects

  • Character: Matthew Mercer — Matthew Mercer is the Dungeon Master who made Critical Role's Exandria table.
  • Work: Campaign 1 — Campaign 1 is Critical Role's first streamed campaign.
  • Work: Campaign 2 — Campaign 2 is Critical Role's Wildemount campaign.
  • Faction: Critical Role Productions — Critical Role Productions produces the streams and spin-off series.
  • Work: Campaign 3 — Campaign 3 is Critical Role's Marquet campaign.
  • Character: Laura Bailey — Laura Bailey is a founding player at the Critical Role table.

What is Critical Role?

Critical Role is the streamed table where Matthew Mercer runs Exandria for a cast of voice actors: Campaign 1's Vox Machina, Campaign 2's Mighty Nein, Campaign 3's Bells Hells, and the Amazon adaptation The Legend of Vox Machina.

Key threads lead to Matthew Mercer, Campaign 1, Campaign 2, Critical Role Productions, Campaign 3 and Laura Bailey.
